h1.en: How Rural Diesel Concrete Pump Orders Its Distance Cells
h1.zh: 农村自建房柴油混凝土泵的距离格子按什么顺序印

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints the Rural Diesel Concrete Pump distance text in Xingtai as follows: Horizontal Delivery Distance is 30–50 m. Vertical Delivery Height is 10–30 m. Read each label with its own figure. Horizontal and vertical are not interchangeable when both appear, and a missing vertical cell is not filled from another model. The frame “Electric motor” shows An electric motor presented to Kelvin by James Joule in 1842, Hunterian Museum, Glasgow and does not replace these cells.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把农村自建房柴油混凝土泵的距离文字印成：水平输送距离是30–50 m。 垂直输送高度是10–30 m。每一条标题只带它自己的数字。同一页如果同时有水平和垂直，两者不能对调；没有印出的垂直格也不能用别的型号去填。画面「Electric motor」的主体是An 电动机 presented to Kelvin by James Joule in 1842, Hunterian Museum, Glasgow，不能代替这些格子。

heading.en: Each distance label owns its figure
heading.zh: 每条距离标题只拥有自己的数字

body.en: Horizontal Delivery Distance is 30–50 m. Vertical Delivery Height is 10–30 m. A pipeline loses pressure to friction, so a horizontal run and a vertical rise are different duties. The sheet already separates them when it prints both. Hopper Capacity 0.2 m³. Max. Aggregate Size 1–3 cm. Total Weight 800 kg.
body.zh: 水平输送距离是30–50 m。 垂直输送高度是10–30 m。管路沿程要克服摩擦，水平段和垂直升高不是同一项工作。目录在同时印出两者时已经把它们分开。料斗容积 0.2 m³。最大骨料粒径 1–3 cm。整机重量 800 kg。

heading.en: The frame is not a measuring tape

body.en: Source page: en.wikipedia.org, “Electric motor”. Subject: An electric motor presented to Kelvin by James Joule in 1842, Hunterian Museum, Glasgow. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not read a metre figure off that frame. If a distance cell is missing on the Rural Diesel Concrete Pump sheet, it stays missing.
body.zh: 来源页：en.wikipedia.org，「Electric motor」。主体：An 电动机 presented to Kelvin by James Joule in 1842, Hunterian Museum, Glasgow。河北品锦机械不从这一帧上读米数。农村自建房柴油混凝土泵这一页如果少了某一距离格，就让它继续空着。

body.en: Theoretical Output is 5–8 m³/h and Pumping Pressure is 15 MPa. Neither cell is a metre. Do not paste another manufacturer's boom length onto Rural Diesel Concrete Pump.
body.zh: 理论输送量是5–8 m³/h，泵送压力是15 MPa。这两格都不是米。不要把别的厂家臂长贴到农村自建房柴油混凝土泵上。

question.en: Which distance text does Rural Diesel Concrete Pump print?
question.zh: 农村自建房柴油混凝土泵印了哪几句距离？

answer.en: Horizontal Delivery Distance is 30–50 m. Vertical Delivery Height is 10–30 m.
answer.zh: 水平输送距离是30–50 m。 垂直输送高度是10–30 m。

question.en: Can horizontal and vertical be swapped?
question.zh: 水平和垂直可以对调吗？

answer.en: Only when the label itself puts them in that order. Keep the printed order.
answer.zh: 只有标题本身写成那个顺序时才按那个顺序。保留印出来的次序。

answer.en: No. Metres come from the catalogue cells that exist.
answer.zh: 不会。米数只来自已经印出的目录格。
